meta_description:
2,643 likes, 34 comments - unicef on October 29, 2026: "Afghanistan is one of two countries where wild polio continues to circulate.

Afifa, Mursal, Parasto and community mobilizers and vaccinators like them are on a mission to change that.

Through their determination, 12.7 million children have been vaccinated against the disease.

“Our work has not yet finished, our work still continues until we eradicate polio,” says Afifa.

#WordPolioDay".
